decision.hypothesis: A throttle-free D hold at 13 mph zeroed the car exactly like the coupled holds did, so any steer input at 13+ mph is fatal regardless of throttle. Steering must happen only at low speed. From this standstill plain W should start a forward roll.
decision.memory: Revised rule: the catastrophe threshold applies to steer input itself, not to throttle+steer. At 13+ mph, no steering at all; only plain W, and take bends slowly by managing speed before the curve.
